title: Layer values with different threshold signs
statement: For natural numbers $a,s,c$, define $V(a,k,c)=\\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}(2c-2(a+j)-1)$. The threshold signs of $V(a,s+1,c+1)$ and $V(a,s+1,c)$ differ if and only if $a\\le c<a+s+1$.
